newsitem.title: UGANDA: Ugandan coffee prices higher in week to May 30.
newsitem.headline: Ugandan coffee prices higher in week to May 30.

text.p: Ugandan coffee prices rose in the the week to May 30 and were expected to remain firm and buoyant until mid-July in line with the international market, industry officials and traders said on Friday.
They said arabica parchment rose to between 2,800 and 3,000 shillings ($2.6-2.8) per kg for the week ended May 30 from 2,500 and 2,800 shillings in the previous week.
Kiboko and Fair Average Quality (FAQ) were steady at 750-850 shillings per kg and 1600-1700 shillings per kg respectively.

Coffee sold in that week amounted to 56,662 60-kg bags. Standard Robusta Screen 15 sold reached 35,462 bags while Screen 12 accounted for 13,965 bags. Screen 18 registered the lowest amount of Robusta contracts with 8,130 bags.
Some 2,105 bags of bugisu arabicas were also sold. Industry leaders gave no comparative figures for the week to May 23.
Prices for Robusta Screen 15 ranged from 85.12 cents per pound to 73.50 cents per pound, which was 1.92 cents to 10.5 cents higher than previously.
